{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Palpatines_private_viewing_box.png|thumb|250px|The private box, in use by Palpatine at a showing of ''Squid Lake''.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] possessed a '''private viewing box''' within the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Palpatine discreetly financed the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house to disguise the financial woes of its owner [[Romeo Treblanc]], in exchange he received the private box with heightened security that made it impossible to be eavesdropped upon. Palpatine paid for the security experts to do the work on the box.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|romeotreblanc|Treblanc, Romeo}}</ref>

The box was directly adjacent to Treblanc's [[Romeo Treblanc's private viewing box|own box]].<ref name="DB" /> After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Palpatine attended a performance of the opera ''[[Squid Lake]]'' alongside [[Senior Administrative Aide]] [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]], [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]], and a member of the [[Red Guard]]. At that performance, Palpatine recounted the [[Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise/Legends|tragedy]] of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as part of his scheme to turn Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Palpatine's private box first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], written by [[Matthew Stover]]<ref name="ROTS-N">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> and released on [[April 2]], [[2005]]<ref name="ROTS-N release">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> ahead of the private box's appearance in the film itself<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that year.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The box later appeared in the [[2006]] non-[[canon]] comic ''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]'', written by [[Kevin Rubio]], with the performance of ''Squid Lake'' seen in ''Revenge of the Sith'' spoofed with the Mon Calamari ballet dancers replaced by characters from the film [[Wikipedia:Finding Nemo|''Finding Nemo'']].<ref name="Tag & Bink">''[[Tag & Bink: Revenge of the Clone Menace]]''</ref>
